title: empetrum nigrum subsp. albidum
intro: Empetrum nigrum subsp. albidum, commonly known as white crowberry, is a subspecies of the empetrum nigrum plant, a low-growing, woody shrub native to Arctic and subarctic regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may help alleviate digestive issues and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of white crowberry are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which may exert antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of white crowberry have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
